text:
Maya: Quick question—vendor telemetry for MI300/Gaudi thermal behavior. Ken, do we have canonical fw/kernel images and a test matrix we should run before the marketplace onramp? Need to finalise cert windows by EOW.
Jonas: For marketplace compatibility, we usually need image + boot args + reference perf logs. Can you share the expected acceptance thresholds? e.g., sustained clocks, throttling % < X
Priya: Also: can hw partner provide a power-limited profile or KVM we can run in our infra? We hit a thermal regression in staging last month for long seqs.
Ken (NPU Partner): Yup — we put together a test bundle. S3: s3://partner-artifacts/mi300-gaudi/2026-03-10/tests.tar.gz. Firmware tag: partner-fw-v3.2.1 (build 2026-03-02). Notes: MI300 has new microcode that changes thermal stepping; run "power-profile=conservative" to mirror cloud rack settings.
Ciara: Timeline check — if we get test runs back next Tue, can we still hit the marketplace announcement on 4/8? Also need to coordinate press embargo window w/ marketing.
Maya: Good. Plan: vendor uploads tests today, eng runs baseline Tue, partner run Wed, feature freeze Thu. Can marketing hold 4/8 as tentative? @Ciara
Jonas: Here's the harness snippet we used in staging:
```
./run_infra_test.sh --image s3://.../image.qcow2 --boot-args="rd.verbose=0 power-profile=conservative" --seq-len=4096 --runtime 7200
```
Priya: I'll add a thermal monitor hook and KV cache stress. If results show >5% throttling we'll file a regression and ask for microcode rollback test.
Ken (NPU Partner): Acknowledge. We'll also provide per-step telemetry (fan RPM, board temps, VDC) in CSV. Expect uploads by EOD.
announce-bot: Deployment note — test bundle uploaded by Ken to s3://partner-artifacts/mi300-gaudi/2026-03-10/tests.tar.gz :white_check_mark:
Maya: Thanks all — syncing calendar invite for Wed 10:30 PT dry-run with @Jonas @Priya @Ken @Ciara. I'll attach the acceptance checklist. :thumbsup:
